headline: Neoenergia Exits Dardanelos Hydroelectric Plant via 25% Stake Sale
summary: Brazilian power utility Neoenergia sold its 25% stake in Brasil Hidro Participações, marking its complete exit from the Dardanelos Hydroelectric Power Plant.
why: Neoenergia S.A. is a major Brazilian electricity holding company controlled by Spain's Iberdrola, focusing on portfolio optimization.
